Even though we prepare well, sometimes we will face some sorts of problems while attempting the IELTS exams. You must be complete fine when you make a mistake while you are speaking. Moreover, you must be aware that mistakes usually tend to happen when you are trying to talk too quickly. This also happens when you are uttering a word accidentally. So you must keep you calm and relaxed when such situation arises. Practicing your IELTS speaking with a tutor or friend will help you to become better. The Casper Academy of Excellence is a leading IELTS coaching centre in Ernakulam to provide best classes.

What to do when you don’t Understand Something?

During the IELTS speaking, when you don’t understand something, be honest to respond. Rather than answering wrong, you can say sorry and ask them to elaborate. This will help you to understand the question better and thereby to answer better.

Not understanding the question may be a problem that we face unexpectedly. It may happen to anyone who is attempting the exam. Thus knowing about this is important. Few Strategies that will help you in your IELTS Speaking

You can try to use advanced vocabulary to express yourself. Moreover, don’t try using the same words and phrases in the same sentence. Another important thing is you must take care of the grammar used in the question. For example, if the examiner is asking you, ‘How was your experience?’ Your answer must be like, ‘It was good’. Similarly, when the question from examiner is like, ‘How is your experience?’ Your answer must be like, ‘It is good’.
